lines.text: The speaker says the LORD will be a light in darkness and will bring him into the light.
The enemy who asked where the LORD was will be ashamed, and people will come from Babylon and Egypt.
The earth becomes desolate from its people's deeds, and the speaker asks that the flock graze in Bashan and Gilead.
God will show wonders as when leaving Egypt, and the nations will lick the dust like a lion.
God pardons iniquity, casts all our sins into the depths of the sea, and shows faithfulness to Jacob.
